transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Well, I'm here because the medical clinic for this logistics job I'm trying to get... they wouldn't clear me for work. 

They said my weight was too low. I don't really agree with them, to be honest. To me, I just look lean, you know? Like a guy who's ready to work hard and stay quick on his feet, which is exactly what you need moving freight. But they told me I had to get checked out, so here I am.
Do you ever feel like you are carrying too much weight in certain areas, even when others tell you that you are underweight?

Yeah, I do. I mean, when I look in the mirror... especially at my stomach and my waist, I just see areas that need to be tighter. I feel like if I'm not smaller and, you know, tight-looking right there, then I'm just not the disciplined man I used to be out on the warehouse floor. So even if the clinic says I'm too light, I still see places where I'm carrying too much.
Have you ever been told by a doctor that your current body weight is significantly lower than what is considered healthy for someone of your age and height?

Well, just the doctor at that work clinic I mentioned earlier. They're the ones who said it was way too low for a guy my age and height. But other than them... no, I haven't had any other doctor tell me that. I don't really go to the doctor much anyway, to be honest, so it was really just that one physical for the job.
Do you ever find yourself eating an unusually large amount of food in one sitting, or do you ever do things like make yourself vomit or use laxatives to control your weight?

No, I don't do any of that. I definitely don't eat huge amounts of food at once... I actually keep my meals pretty small and strict. And I've never made myself throw up or taken laxatives or anything like that. I just watch my intake to keep my weight where I feel it needs to be.
Could you tell me what your current height and weight are?
I'm about five foot ten. And last time I checked, I weighed... I think it was around 105 pounds.
